highlights: Collapsible, searchable chat sidebar with Chats, Recordings, Trash, pinning, rename, and recoverable deletion; existing History and New chat controls remain available.
Sent messages show Copy and Edit controls on hover or keyboard focus, with Show more chevrons, exact code spacing, text selection, and draft-preserving edit/resend.
Optional saved-chat context uses compact recent and relevant history with isolated preferences and no extra memory-generation API calls; added context stays bounded.
Stop controls, request deadlines, bounded audio buffering, safer screen capture, and renderer recovery preserve partial answers and allow the next query.
Meeting-mode instructions support up to 64,000 characters, and a desktop toggle chooses this desktop or all desktops.
Clean Apple silicon and Intel builds include the matching local Whisper runtime; model files download separately.
